query:
update nationality
           set
               national_name = coalesce($3, national_name),
               nation = coalesce($4, nation),
               sort_order = coalesce($5, sort_order),
               is_active = coalesce($6, is_active),
               updated_by = $2,
               updated_at = now()
           where id = $1 and deleted_at is null
